about: The home page, as one noun: the film (one or more cuts, with a default), a statement in two labelled parts, the use case and the architecture underneath, and the decks. The first part's line is the page's heading. scripts/build_site.py renders it into site/index.html.
title: Agora, the ta-amps overview
description: Agora is the ta-amps overview: the three-minute film, five decks, use cases and how the system keeps learning. The use case is Eranos, spare tokens for good. The architecture underneath is nouns and verbs: verbs are tasks, and nouns are everything they use and make.
